segments.an5.79:1.1: “Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, anāgatabhayāni etarahi asamuppannāni āyatiṃ samuppajjissanti.
segments.an5.79:2.2: Bhavissanti, bhikkhave, bhikkhū anāgatamaddhānaṃ abhāvitakāyā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā.
segments.an5.79:2.3: Te abhāvitakāyā samānā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā aññe upasampādessanti.
segments.an5.79:2.4: Tepi [te (sī.)] na sakkhissanti vinetuṃ adhisīle adhicitte adhipaññāya.
segments.an5.79:2.5: Tepi bhavissanti abhāvitakāyā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā.
segments.an5.79:2.6: Te abhāvitakāyā samānā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā aññe upasampādessanti.
segments.an5.79:2.7: Tepi [te (?)] na sakkhissanti vinetuṃ adhisīle adhicitte adhipaññāya.
segments.an5.79:2.8: Tepi bhavissanti abhāvitakāyā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā.
segments.an5.79:2.11: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ etarahi asamuppannaṃ āyatiṃ samuppajjissati.
segments.an5.79:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhavissanti bhikkhū anāgatamaddhānaṃ abhāvitakāyā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā.
segments.an5.79:3.2: Te abhāvitakāyā samānā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā aññesaṃ nissayaṃ dassanti.
segments.an5.79:3.3: Tepi na sakkhissanti vinetuṃ adhisīle adhicitte adhipaññāya.
segments.an5.79:3.4: Tepi bhavissanti abhāvitakāyā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā.
segments.an5.79:3.5: Te abhāvitakāyā samānā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā aññesaṃ nissayaṃ dassanti.
segments.an5.79:3.6: Tepi na sakkhissanti vinetuṃ adhisīle adhicitte adhipaññāya.
segments.an5.79:3.7: Tepi bhavissanti abhāvitakāyā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā.
segments.an5.79:3.10: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ etarahi asamuppannaṃ āyatiṃ samuppajjissati.
segments.an5.79:4.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhavissanti bhikkhū anāgatamaddhānaṃ abhāvitakāyā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā.
segments.an5.79:4.2: Te abhāvitakāyā samānā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā abhidhammakathaṃ vedallakathaṃ kathentā kaṇhadhammaṃ okkamamānā na bujjhissanti.
segments.an5.79:4.5: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ etarahi asamuppannaṃ āyatiṃ samuppajjissati.
segments.an5.79:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhavissanti bhikkhū anāgatamaddhānaṃ abhāvitakāyā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā.
segments.an5.79:5.2: Te abhāvitakāyā samānā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā ye te suttantā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīratthā lokuttarā suññatāppaṭisaṃyuttā, tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsissanti, na sotaṃ odahissanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapessanti, na ca te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññissanti.
segments.an5.79:5.3: Ye pana te suttantā kavitā [kavikatā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī., saṃ. ni.2.229) ṭīkā oloketabbā] kāveyyā cittakkharā cittabyañjanā bāhirakā sāvakabhāsitā, tesu bhaññamānesu sussūsissanti, sotaṃ odahissanti, aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapessanti, te ca dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññissanti.
segments.an5.79:5.6: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, catutthaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ etarahi asamuppannaṃ āyatiṃ samuppajjissati.
segments.an5.79:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhavissanti bhikkhū anāgatamaddhānaṃ abhāvitakāyā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā.
segments.an5.79:6.2: Te abhāvitakāyā samānā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā therā bhikkhū bāhulikā [bāhullikā (syā. kaṃ.) a. ni.2.49;3.96] bhavissanti sāthalikā okkamane pubbaṅgamā paviveke nikkhittadhurā, na vīriyaṃ ārabhissanti appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an5.79:6.4: Sāpi bhavissati bāhulikā sāthalikā okkamane pubbaṅgamā paviveke nikkhittadhurā, na vīriyaṃ ārabhissati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an5.79:6.7: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, pañcamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ etarahi asamuppannaṃ āyatiṃ samuppajjissati.
segments.an5.79:7.1: “Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca anāgatabhayāni etarahi asamuppannāni āyatiṃ samuppajjissanti.

lines: Kathaṃ pana dhammasmiṃ dussante vinayo dussati nāma?
Samathavipassanādhammesu gabbhaṃ aggaṇhantesu pañcavidho vinayo na hoti, evaṃ dhamme dussante vinayo dussati.
Dussīlassa pana saṃvaravinayo nāma na hoti, tasmiṃ asati samathavipassanā gabbhaṃ na gaṇhāti.
Apica duṭṭhacittena puggalaṃ ghaṭṭentāpi taṃ kaṇhadhammaṃ attano dahantāpi lābhasakkāratthaṃ kathentāpi kaṇhadhammaṃ okkamantiyeva.
Na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapessantīti jānanatthāya cittaṃ na ṭhapessanti.
Sesamettha heṭṭhā vuttanayattā suviññeyyattā ca uttānatthameva.
Navame pāḷigambhīrāti (saṃ. ni. ṭī.2.2.229) pāḷivasena gambhīrā agādhā dukkhogāhā sallasuttasadisā.
Sallasutta ñhi (su. ni.579)“animittamanaññātan”tiādinā pāḷivasena gambhīraṃ, na atthagambhīraṃ.
Tathā hi tattha tā tā gāthā duviññeyyarūpā tiṭṭhanti.
Pubbāparaṃpettha kāsañci gāthānaṃ duviññeyyatāya dukkhogāhameva, tasmā pāḷivasena gambhīraṃ.
Atthagambhīrāti atthavasena gambhīrā mahāvedallasuttasadisā, mahāvedallasuttassa (ma. ni.1.449 ādayo) atthavasena gambhīratā pākaṭāyeva.
Lokaṃ uttaratīti lokuttaro, so atthabhūto etesaṃ atthīti lokuttarā.
Uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbanti ca liṅgavacanavipallāsena vuttanti āha “uggahetabbe ceva vaḷañjetabbe cā”ti.
Yassa pana yaṃ kammaṃ, taṃ tena katanti vuccatīti āha “kavitāti kavīhi katā”ti.
Sussūsissantīti akkharacittatāya ceva sarasampattiyā ca attamanā hutvā sāmaṇeradaharabhikkhumātugāmamahāgahapatikādayo “esa dhammakathiko”ti sannipatitvā sotukāmā bhavissanti.
